proposal.summary: OpenEDX Platform Ironwood 2.5 allows authenticated users to submit custom Python problem code which can execute arbitrary OS commands on the host, resulting in remote code execution.

PR.quote: This is an authenticated vulnerability, so you need to register an account, go to /edx-studio

C.quote: and click Submit, and you will execute commands in the machine

I.quote: and click Submit, and you will execute commands in the machine

A.quote: and click Submit, and you will execute commands in the machine

proposal.recommended_next_step: Disable or restrict the 'Custom Python evaluated code' feature and enforce use of CodeJail for sandboxing; if not possible, remove the feature until a secure sandboxing/validation patch is available.
